population_boundary: Durable complete, OpenAP-supported and successfully first-pass-modelled flights before the four release quality gates; upstream ingestion exclusions remain outside this design.

selection_audit.weight_interpretation: Exposure proxy used only to weight sensitivity contrasts across failure masks; it is neither the rejected flights' ideal airborne CO2 nor an estimated missing outcome.

reference.contrast_source: For each usable OpenSky failure mask, proxy component minus the OpenSky 0000 proxy component. The 4.61-point primary-versus-OpenSky level offset is not transferred.

failure_mask_proxy_mapping.reason: No usable OpenSky proxy and no larger same-mechanism mask; impose zero contrast.
No usable OpenSky proxy for flown-distance plus short-sector failure; impose zero contrast.
Use the observed coverage contrast; the additional short-sector mechanism has no usable proxy.
Use the observed coverage contrast; the additional flown-distance and short-sector mechanisms have no usable proxy.
Use the observed endpoint contrast; the additional short-sector mechanism has no usable proxy.
Use the observed endpoint-plus-coverage contrast; the additional short-sector mechanism has no usable proxy.

stress_ladder.interpretation: Half the magnitude of the observed one-day failure-mask contrasts.
The magnitude of the observed one-day failure-mask contrasts; not a best estimate.
Twice the magnitude of the observed one-day failure-mask contrasts.

profiles.rule: Preserve the sign and component vector observed for each mapped OpenSky failure mask.
Reverse each whole contrast vector when necessary so every mapped mask lowers the total gap by its declared magnitude.
Reverse each whole contrast vector when necessary so every mapped mask raises the total gap by its declared magnitude.

propagation.mask_assumed_gap: frozen passed-flight headline component plus stress scale times the selected contrast component
propagation.full_population_gap: first-pass-CO2-exposure-weighted mean of the frozen passed-flight headline and the assumed rejected-mask gaps
propagation.selection_shift: full-population sensitivity gap minus the frozen passed-flight headline
propagation.priority_ranking: descending absolute contribution to the centrale adverse envelope for gap_total_pct
propagation.component_identity: total must equal lateral plus vertical before and after propagation, within floating-point tolerance

claims.interpretation: A transparent stress ladder conditional on the durable pre-gate population. It exposes cancellation and scale; it does not estimate missing outcomes or upstream selection.

privacy: Aggregate inputs and outputs only; no flight identifiers, times, endpoints or source track rows are read or emitted.
